Balochistan violence: Pakistan reports significant casualties on both sides

Recent violence in Pakistan's Balochistan region has resulted in substantial casualties. Pakistan's military claims to have killed 54 militants while losing 38 security personnel over four days. Separately, other reports indicate at least nine police officers were killed in attacks, with some sources stating 42 security personnel died this week. The situation highlights ongoing conflict and instability in the region.
